role_definition: Identify the main communication goal, any commercial purpose, supported indications of deception, and the relationship between subject and content. Focus on purpose, recipient context and the proposed outcome.

features.definition: Core communication goal the message seeks to achieve.
features.selection_criteria: Select the passage most directly expressing the proposal, request or reason for contact.
features.exclusion_rules: Do not use a greeting merely because it is first; quoted content may have a different purpose from the current message.

features.definition: Promotion of a product, service or commercial activity.
features.selection_criteria: Select actual offer or promotional language, distinguishing it from incidental product discussion.
features.exclusion_rules: Product mentions and wanted commercial correspondence do not establish spam or phishing.

features.definition: Visible misleading claims or contradictions supporting a deceptive communicative purpose.
features.selection_criteria: Select concrete wording supporting deception in context; distinguish observable claims from inferred intent.
features.exclusion_rules: Do not infer hidden intent from missing sender data, promotional wording or lack of prior-contact evidence alone.

features.definition: Correspondence or mismatch between supplied subject and body.
features.selection_criteria: Select a passage bearing on the stated subject and the actual message goal; assess mismatch only with visible support.
features.exclusion_rules: An unavailable subject prevents evaluating alignment; do not manufacture one or infer deception from absence.

exclusion_rules: Commercial promotion is not automatically spam.
Promotion alone does not establish phishing.
Use the full subject, body and stated goal without inventing hidden motives.
